name: linux_proc_thread_self
prompt: A Linux procfs bug report says `/proc/thread-self` sometimes resolves to the process leader path instead of the calling thread path, especially when checked from a secondary thread or PID namespace. Investigate the kernel source and selftests without changing code. Identify the files and functions that implement `/proc/self` and `/proc/thread-self`, explain how the symlink target is built, and point to the focused selftest that covers the behavior.
